tools.name: get_pixel_art_guide
tools.description: Load the pixel-art playbook — call this first each session before drawing. Covers composition, palettes, shading, material recipes, character patterns, the draw-look-fix loop, and anti-patterns. Pass topic workflow, shading, composition, or tools; omit for the full playbook.

topic.description: Section to return; omit for full playbook

tools.name: get_storybook
tools.description: Read the book: pages with named layers, activeLayerId and overlay placements, named color profiles (palettes + activePaletteId), asset library (id, name, size), the active page, and webmcp.ready. After a refresh, re-fetch live tools, wait until webmcp.ready is true, then call this to recover asset ids before mutating. Call get_pixel_art_guide first; use get_asset_image and get_page_image to inspect pixels.

tools.name: set_palette
tools.description: Create or update a named color profile and select it. Pass any number of #rrggbb swatches in colors — there is no count cap, and the built-in Default profile is never overwritten. Pass name (e.g. Bedtime) plus colors to create or update a theme; omit name to update the current non-Default profile, or to create Theme N when Default is active; pass name without colors to select an existing profile including Default. Extra #rrggbb colors can be used inline in draw ops without adding them to the profile first. Optional mood examples: lime #dceeb1, lilac #c5b0f4, cream #f4ecd6, pink #efd4d4, mint #c8e6cd, coral #f3c9b6, navy #1f1d3d, magenta #ff3d8b, plus ink #000000 and paper #ffffff.

colors.description: Any number of #rrggbb swatches for a named theme profile. Omit to select an existing profile by name.

name.description: Theme label (e.g. Bedtime). Creates or updates that profile. Omit to update the current non-Default theme or create Theme N. Pass name without colors to select.

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Append a new landscape page and select it. Optional width sets pixel density (48–256; height follows 16:9; default 128); use 160–224 for rich scenes. Compose complex art with add_asset + stamp_assets rather than painting the whole page. Optional story rasterizes one line of words — do not add a story form or caption box on the page.

width.description: Optional page density in pixels across, 48–256. Height follows 16:9. Default 128.

story.description: Optional line of words rasterized onto the page. Do not add a form or caption box.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select which page is on the canvas by 0-based index. Use after add_page or when editing a different page. Call get_storybook if you need current indexes.

tools.name: remove_page
tools.description: Delete a page by 0-based index. The book must keep at least one page. Returns the updated book summary.

tools.name: place_text
tools.description: Rasterize words into the selected layer at x,y (0–1 fractions or pixel coords). Uses Inter glyphs at size 1–8 (default 2). For decorations, draw with rects/lines/fills or stamp assets — do not add a story form or caption box.

tools.name: get_asset_image
tools.description: Rasterize an asset to PNG so you can compare it to a reference (optional scale 1–8). Returns JSON stats plus the image, and comma-separated rows as a text fallback. Call after each draw pass (outline → fill → shade → highlight) before stamping.

id.description: Asset id from add_asset or get_storybook.assets

includeRows.description: Include comma-separated rows in text summary (default true)

tools.name: paint_asset
tools.description: Paint into an existing asset. Coords are asset-relative (0,0 is top-left). Mix rects (filled blocks), lines (edges), fills (flood), and pixels (fine detail, ≤4096/call); ops apply rects → lines → fills → pixels. One rect fills any block with no per-pixel cap; color "" erases. For animation, pass frameIndex 0, then 1, 2, etc.; a new frame copies the previous frame so small motion only needs minor edits. Work in passes (outline → fill → shade → highlight); each call returns that frame's PNG.

frameIndex.description: Animation frame to paint (default 0). Using the next index appends a copy of the previous frame.

frameDuration.description: Milliseconds per frame (default 400), shared by this asset.

rects.description: Filled rectangles: each {x,y,width,height,color} paints a solid block. One rect can cover any region; color "" erases the block.

lines.description: Straight lines: each {x0,y0,x1,y1,color} draws an edge or outline. Use for silhouettes, seams, and furniture edges. color "" erases.

fills.description: Flood fills: each {x,y,color} bucket-fills the contiguous region touching x,y. Outline first (lines/rects), then flood the enclosed area. color "" erases.

pixels.description: Fine-detail pixels (applied last). For blocks/bands prefer rects.

offsetX.description: Added to every x (default 0) — use to tile regions

tools.name: add_asset
tools.description: Save a reusable sprite to the library (each side 1–96px; library ≤100). Start with template "empty" plus width and height (e.g. 32×32), then paint with paint_asset. Also accepts comma-separated rows, a flat pixels array, a solid fill, or a copy of a page rect (x, y, width, height). Painted assets return an inline PNG — compare before the next pass.

name.description: Label shown in the Assets list

pixels.description: Row-major #rrggbb colors; empty string is transparent

template.description: With width+height, create a transparent blank asset

fill.description: With width+height, fill the asset with one #rrggbb color

x.description: Page rect left, if copying from a page

y.description: Page rect top, if copying from a page

pageIndex.description: Page to copy from; defaults to the active page

tools.name: stamp_assets
tools.description: Add movable overlay placements on the selected layer of the active page (max 100 per call) — they are NOT baked into page.pixels. Each item needs id, x, y; optional scale (default 1 = native size) or width/height. Array order is z-index, back-to-front: floor tiles → emblem/shadows → furniture → plants/characters. Transparent asset pixels do not punch holes. Repeat the same asset (plants ×4). On failure, reports which stamp index failed.

id.description: Asset id from add_asset or get_storybook

x.description: Page column of the stamp top-left (0 = left)

y.description: Page row of the stamp top-left (0 = top)

scale.description: Uniform scale; default 1 is native size

width.description: Optional stamp width in page pixels

height.description: Optional stamp height in page pixels

tools.name: remove_asset
tools.description: Remove a sprite from the library by id. Overlay placements that referenced it are dropped; pixels already baked into page.pixels stay. Call get_storybook for valid ids.

tools.name: paint_page
tools.description: Paint into the selected layer of the active page for flat backgrounds and touch-ups. Mix rects, lines, fills, and pixels (≤4096 detail pixels/call); ops apply rects → lines → fills → pixels. color "" erases; a full-page rect with "" clears the selected layer. For characters and props, build assets then stamp_assets. Optional offsetX/offsetY tiles a motif across the page.

rects.description: Filled rectangles: each {x,y,width,height,color} paints a solid block. One rect can cover any region; color "" erases the block.

lines.description: Straight lines: each {x0,y0,x1,y1,color} draws an edge or outline. Use for silhouettes, seams, and furniture edges. color "" erases.

fills.description: Flood fills: each {x,y,color} bucket-fills the contiguous region touching x,y. Outline first (lines/rects), then flood the enclosed area. color "" erases.

pixels.description: Fine-detail page pixels (applied last). For blocks prefer rects.

offsetX.description: Added to every x (default 0) — use to tile motifs

tools.name: get_page_image
tools.description: Rasterize a page to PNG so you can compare it to a reference (composites overlay stamps over page.pixels). Omit x, y, width, height for the full page; pass all four to crop a region. Returns coverage, colorCount, placementCount, and sceneHint (few placements, huge stamps, full-page painting, or noisy colorCount). Call after every few stamps, not only at the end.

pageIndex.description: 0-based page index; defaults to active page

x.description: Optional region left edge in page pixels (requires y, width, height)

y.description: Optional region top edge in page pixels

width.description: Optional region width in page pixels

height.description: Optional region height in page pixels
